findings.desc: scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:564-579 asserts DEV phaseTools with a regex block plus substring includes. Because the check does not parse quoted command entries, a stale comment or longer identifier containing finding_cluster/finding_dispatch/bug_report can satisfy or fail the contract without matching runtime command availability, weakening the adversarial guard against unintended command-surface changes. Prefer reusing isCommandAllowed/getAllowedPatterns from built config or a token parser that only accepts exact string-literal array entries.

scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs:564 uses raw substring checks over the DEV phaseTools source block, so the process-fact contract can pass if finding_cluster is removed from the actual string array but left in a comment; parse the string literals or reuse isCommandAllowed so the hard guard verifies executable policy. severity=low
